text:
Asakusa has four stations with the same name.
From Narita, the direct train stops at only one 👇

✈️ Keisei's Access Express runs straight through.
About 70 minutes, ¥1,380, no change.

🔁 The Tsukuba Express station needs two changes.
72 minutes and ¥3,010.

🧳 "3 minutes from the station" can mean
a 670 m walk from where your train stops.

✅ Big bags? Book near the Toei Asakusa station.

👉 Every route and price:
https://japanbystation.com/asakusa-which-station-from-narita
